toil-audit/makefile.candidate: Running `make` with no target lists every available verb with its description
`make setup` installs the development dependencies and the pre-commit hook
`make run` runs the analyser with ARGS, defaulting to --help
`make test` runs the test suite with pytest
`make lint` runs every pre-commit hook over every file
`make format` formats the tree with ruff
`make analyze` refuses with exit 69 and an install link when trivy is missing, otherwise scans for CRITICAL/HIGH vulnerabilities, misconfiguration and secrets
`make install` runs `pip install .`, even though the section header and CLAUDE.md call it a declared no-op (the package has no packaging metadata), so it contradicts its own docs
`make build` prints that there is nothing to build and points to README > Not applicable

toilaudit/attribute.candidate: Identities are de-duplicated and sorted for stable output
file_of strips the ::case name to get the file
Per-test (by_test) cost totals kept alongside per-file
Shares accumulated at 6 decimals and rounded to cents once at the end
Zip logs read in memory, never written to disk
Directory entries and unreadable members of the zip are skipped

toilaudit/compare.candidate: Comparison record shape (boundary, windows as month/value pairs, fix cost field)
Commit sha matching is case-insensitive and accepts a prefix of 7+ characters
Month series walks calendar months including December→January rollover
Empty run list yields an empty month series
Partial first/last months are dropped before comparing
A clean last month is the headline and appears in the monthly trend

toilaudit/costing.candidate: Rounding of minutes to 0.1 and euros to cents in each figure
Shared templates appear only when copied into more than one repository, top 8
Signal cost helper sums engineer and compute per signal
Frozen result data structures CostLine, TemplateLine, CostSummary
Template entries ordered most expensive first

toilaudit/fetch.candidate: Pages are requested 100 at a time and pagination stops on an empty or short page
Saved page file names are a hash of the URL so a query string cannot escape the directory
Request headers: Accept, X-GitHub-Api-Version 2022-11-28, User-Agent toil-audit
One extra second added to the rate-limit wait to absorb clock skew
Exit codes for a missing token and for rate limiting
--no-cache forces a fresh fetch and skips the cache
Injected opener, sleep and clock for testing

toilaudit/ingest.candidate: Jenkins run id uses the controller-wide queue id, falling back to the build number
Workflow label prefixes the repository (owner/repo/workflow) so names don't collide across repos
Template identity is the workflow file path, else the workflow name
A broken commit is identified by (repo, sha)
Negative queue or run time clamped to zero
GitHub run with no conclusion reads as in_progress; missing run_started_at falls back to created_at; title is the first line of display title or commit message
GitLab workflow name defaults to .gitlab-ci.yml and every pipeline shares that template path
JENKINS_TREE query string the operator passes to api/json
Git remote URL parsing variants (https, scp-style, ssh with port, case-folded host)
Jenkins builds without a timestamp are dropped
Jenkins export accepts either allBuilds or builds key
Provider name to loader lookup (github, gitlab, jenkins)
Runs returned sorted by queue time

toilaudit/patterns.candidate: Regexes are compiled in one module and nowhere else from literals
Identities are de-duplicated and sorted for a stable report
Cost of a recovery is split evenly across its failing tests and partitions the total
toilaudit/patterns.covered_by: belongs to flaky-attribution/offender-ranking (attribute module), not enforced in patterns.py

toilaudit/report.candidate: Costliest workflows list capped at 8 and sample incidents capped at the 10 largest
Flaky test attribution section placed before the workflow rankings
Euro formatting with thousands separators and two decimals
Generated-at footer timestamp and methodology pointer
Complete-month detection by first/last run day

toilaudit/signals.candidate: Per-signal minute overrides passed to detect_signals
A success with the same run id as the remembered failure is not a recovery
Next-push index sorted per repository and branch, found by bisection
Negative gap to the next push clamped to zero
Signal record shape (kind, run, detail, minutes, compute)
Every red run bills its runner time
A fan-out copy that was never fixed is still capped at 1 minute

toilaudit/toilaudit.candidate: --since passed to the GitHub fetch as a created>= filter
Before/after comparison and ROI wording in the report
